description: This file defines the InputViewBinder interface, which specifies methods for managing and interacting with an input view in a keyboard application, including keyboard state management, resource handling, and UI configuration.

methods.name: getThemedKeyboardDimens
methods.description: Returns the KeyboardDimens object describing the UI for the current keyboard view and theme.

methods.name: onViewNotRequired
methods.description: Called when the view is no longer needed, allowing it to release resources.

methods.name: setControl
methods.description: Sets the state of the control key of the keyboard.

methods.name: setShifted
methods.description: Sets the state of the shift key of the keyboard.

methods.name: isShifted
methods.description: Returns whether the shift key is currently active.

methods.name: setShiftLocked
methods.description: Sets the CAPS-LOCK state of the keyboard.

methods.name: resetInputView
methods.description: Resets the input view, returning true if something was closed.

methods.name: setKeyboard
methods.description: Attaches a keyboard to the view, allowing for switching and re-layout.

methods.name: setKeyboardActionType
methods.description: Sets the IME options for the current input connection.

methods.name: isShown
methods.description: Checks if the view is currently visible.

methods.name: setWatermark
methods.description: Sets watermark drawables for the input view.
